echoParts: And I will ask the Father
verseText: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever — the Spirit of truth...
meaning: Jesus knew he would return to heaven and leave his disciples. So promised that the Father would give his followers another Helper, the Holy Spirit, who would always be with them.

recall.question: An Advocate is someone who helps and speaks up for others. Who is the Advocate Jesus promise the Father would send?

meaning.question: How long did Jesus promise the Holy Spirit would stay with His followers?

application.prompt: Jesus knew His followers would need help after He returned to heaven, so He promised to send the Holy Spirit! If you believe in Jesus, you're never alone. God's Spirit is always with you, helping you understand God's truth and follow Jesus, even when life gets difficult.
